title: Marketing Executive
description: Lead digital marketing campaigns for local and international clients. Develop and execute marketing strategies, manage social media presence, and analyze campaign performance. Ideal candidate has 3+ years experience in digital marketing and strong communication skills.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field, 3+ years experience, proficiency in digital marketing tools, excellent written and verbal communication.

title: Mechanical Technician
description: Maintain industrial equipment and support installation teams. Troubleshoot mechanical issues, perform preventive maintenance, and ensure equipment operates at peak efficiency. This position offers competitive compensation and accommodation.
requirements: Technical diploma or certification, 2+ years experience in mechanical maintenance, ability to read technical diagrams, willingness to relocate.

title: Software Developer
description: Develop and maintain web applications using modern technologies. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions. Work on exciting projects for both local and international clients.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, React or similar frameworks, 2+ years experience.

title: Nurse
description: Provide quality patient care in a modern healthcare facility. Work with a diverse team of healthcare professionals in a supportive environment. Competitive salary and benefits package included.
requirements: Nursing degree and valid license, 2+ years clinical experience, excellent English communication skills, valid passport.

title: Accountant
description: Manage financial records, prepare reports, and ensure compliance with accounting standards. Support financial planning and analysis for growing organization.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance, CPA preferred, 3+ years experience, proficiency in accounting software.
